classification: synthetic truth-first validation data; not field measurements

scenarioDefinitions.atmosphere-omitted: Raw distance requires cycle T/P correction but the configured policy omits it.
scenarioDefinitions.clean: Coherent observations with deterministic instrument noise only.
scenarioDefinitions.curvature-refraction-omitted: One long sight carries the realistic vertical curvature/refraction effect.
scenarioDefinitions.face-i-ii: Face I/II pairs require normalization and circular reduction.
scenarioDefinitions.gross-hz: One horizontal direction contains a controlled gross error.
scenarioDefinitions.gross-sd: One stored distance contains a controlled gross error.
scenarioDefinitions.gross-vz: One zenith angle contains a controlled gross error.
scenarioDefinitions.horizontal-as-slope: A horizontal distance is deliberately interpreted as a slope distance.
scenarioDefinitions.moved-reference: One constrained reference physically moves by 2–3 mm.
scenarioDefinitions.station-vibration: A transient station displacement/orientation burst affects contiguous sights.
